Hunter Walk shares insights from the Homebrew Computer Club
The Homebrew Computer Club is a well-known group of tech enthusiasts who met on the Stanford campus to talk about schematics, programming, and computers. It’s where Steve Jobs met Steve Wozniak, and it served as a starting point for many successful Silicon Valley founders. [...] The club also serves as inspiration for venture capital company, Homebrew. Not your average VC firm, its founders, Hunter Walk and Satya Patel, also believe deeply that sharing information freely and candidly is the key to helping startups in its portfolio move faster and scale bigger.

Here, Hunter shares some of the life lessons he’s learned throughout his own career, the biggest misconception about seed investing, and advice for founders in search of the right investors.
